capability.name: capture_quality_v1
advertiseOnlyWhen: the common processor is installed for recorded_clip, local_self_test and live_ptt
the resolved route is accepted and every required effect is active or explicitly not_required
capture-quality state is visible locally and the additive heartbeat surface is enabled
the platform implementation and deterministic regression tasks pass on the exact build
doesNotAuthorize: an acoustic C3 or hardware claim

workflows.source: explicit local hold or acknowledged toggle
workflows.sink: local Opus encoder and bounded live queue

ownership.controlOwner: one serialized platform capture-quality controller per process
ownership.captureCallback: timestamps device frames and performs bounded nonblocking enqueue only
ownership.renderCallback: timestamps the exact local output samples and performs bounded nonblocking reference-ring enqueue only
ownership.processorWorker: owns format alignment, reference alignment, AEC, NS, AGC and generation state
ownership.sinkWorker: owns draft I/O or live encoding after processed frames leave the processor
ownership.generationRule: every start, route change, device change and terminal teardown advances generation; older capture and reference frames are discarded

stages.output: visible preparing state and fresh generation
48 kHz mono float PCM with capture-clock position
capture-clock-aligned reference or typed unavailable reason
stages.mayBypass: only when AEC requirement is not_required for an accepted headphone route
only as explicit not_required or explicit degraded fallback

stages.output: level-controlled PCM below the input ceiling

stages.input: stop, cancel, failure, route/device change or lifecycle edge
stages.output: closed devices, zero live queues and invalidated generation

renderReference.tap: after program/live/overlay summing, the -1 dBFS post-mix limiter and final non-amplifying local volume; immediately before device submission
includes: recording cues when capture commit is disabled
excludes: samples from an older route generation
renderReference.timestamp: render device sample position plus monotonic host time

alignment.discontinuityAction: stop committing output, advance generation and enter reconfiguring

renderReference.privacy: reference samples are memory-only, bounded to 500 ms, never logged, persisted, uploaded or included in crash reports

routes.autoRule: resolve the current physical route before capture and report the resolved mode; unknown is never accepted
routes.headphoneAEC: active when supported; otherwise not_required only after the route is positively identified as headphones

deviceOrRouteChange.action: stop sample commit and live send, keep the capture indicator visible, advance generation, flush processor/reference/sink queues, resolve and re-arm
deviceOrRouteChange.onTimeout: terminal unsupported with an explicit reason; never resume raw samples

states.indicatorRule: the local visible and accessible indicator enters preparing before permission or device activation, remains visible through fallback consent, capture, reconfiguration and teardown, and clears only after device/reference/processor/sink shutdown completes

receiverOutput.stage: -1 dBFS post-mix limiter followed only by the final non-amplifying local volume before output

fallback.accepted: capture may start without an additional warning
fallback.degraded: show the exact missing effect/reason and require per-session local consent before any microphone sample is committed
fallback.unsupported: do not commit or send microphone samples
fallback.recorded_clip: may offer one explicit unprocessed Phase-1 recording action; it remains quality=degraded and does not advertise capture_quality_v1
fallback.local_self_test: may offer one explicit unprocessed local-only action; it remains quality=degraded and does not advertise capture_quality_v1
fallback.live_ptt: cancel live start and optionally offer the existing separate recorded-clip action; automatic live-to-clip fallback is forbidden
fallback.mixedVersion: a peer without capture_quality_v1 is displayed as unknown quality; it is never upgraded to accepted, but does not block ordinary live_ptt_v1 transport unless product policy explicitly requires quality

heartbeatExtension.authority: client observational state only; coordinator cannot command capture from it

history.rule: do not persist transient route, effect or input-health snapshots in transmission history

privacy.telemetry: categorical state, counters and bounded timings only; no content, device identity or local paths
privacy.manualFixtures: purpose-built consented fixture speech only; never private user capture

order: run legacy clip/live paths only with their existing explicit indicators and claims
